environment.scope: repository-only corrective implementation. Root cause (read-only, privacy-safe) of production withdrawal #4 (owner 29) stuck REQUESTED/pending/account-unresolved: (1) the vantage/v1 parser has no completion template so the genuine 'processed successfully' email classifies as WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTED (prod events #16/#17 both REQUESTED, amount 30); (2) completion correlation is reference-only and Vantage carries no stable reference; (3) the external account login (ending 5017) is never extracted so the owner-scoped Vantage account TA#52 is never bound; (4) the record is MANUAL_STAFF, which the autonomous engine excludes by design (ADR-0092). Fix: Vantage perfective 'processed successfully' completion + single-login extraction (per-broker, additive); a STAFF-GATED completion service + management command (dry-run default) that re-parses the already-linked, already-retained completion evidence, resolves the account owner-scoped (fail-closed), and advances the withdrawal to COMPLETED; currency-safe projection (amount with explicit neutral marker; no cross-currency aggregation). ADR-0093. NO model/schema change, NO migration, NO production mutation, NO deploy. The autonomous correlation engine is intentionally UNCHANGED (ADR-0092 invariant preserved).

expected_results: A genuine Vantage COMPLETION email ('...has been processed successfully') classifies as WITHDRAWAL_COMPLETED (perfective, deposit-vetoed), while the SUBMISSION ('Withdrawal Submitted') and the bare 'request successful' stay WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTED; future ('will be processed successfully'), habitual/promotional ('are processed successfully') and terminal-negative emails are NEVER upgraded to a completion. The single stated login is extracted (unique only), and a 13+ digit PAN is never captured.
The completion parsing and single-login extraction are PER-BROKER (Vantage only); Pepperstone/Dominion/TradersWay parsing is byte-for-byte unchanged.

A staff reviewer can advance ONE MANUAL_STAFF / reference-less withdrawal to COMPLETED from its already-linked completion candidate: the stored blob re-parses to WITHDRAWAL_COMPLETED for the selected broker, the login resolves to EXACTLY ONE owner-scoped account whose suffix matches, amount equals the expected amount, completion post-dates the request within a bounded window; status becomes COMPLETED with completed_at = the completion evidence timestamp, requested_at preserved, currency left as the evidence states it (unknown => '' , never invented), completed_event None (candidate-based evidence model). Idempotent; transaction + row lock; dry-run by default.

Fail-closed (no mutation) on: non-staff reviewer; owner mismatch; not REQUESTED / not MANUAL_STAFF / not REAL / already account-resolved / already completed; completion candidate not linked to the withdrawal's correlation; broker-profile mismatch; evidence that re-parses to something other than WITHDRAWAL_COMPLETED (e.g. the submission candidate); amount mismatch; account unresolved / cross-owner / suffix mismatch; completion before the request.

Projection truthfulness: the completed row renders broker (Vantage), state Completed, masked account suffix (never the full login), no 'Account unresolved' warning after resolution, no fabricated reference, amount shown with an explicit neutral currency marker when currency is unknown, and the unknown-currency amount is NEVER summed into any currency total.

Migration-free, no production mutation, autonomous correlation engine unchanged (ADR-0092 invariant preserved); no raw email body / name / full account number read into any output, commit, test, log or manifest.
